title: Passaporte para Português 1 — topic and vocabulary map

source.coverage: Contents for units 1–40 and 10 practical scenarios; sample unit 1, its grammar page and review/action pages for units 1–4.

method.structure: Transcribed from the contents on PDF pages 4–9 and visually checked across the two-page tables.
method.vocabulary: Assistant-selected core single words aligned to each section. Sample lesson occurrences are individually marked; this is not a complete extracted textbook glossary.
method.cefr: The preview labels the book A1/A2 but does not define a per-unit cutoff. Suggested stages and the A1 track are editorial recommendations, not publisher labels.
method.word_policy: Single words only; hyphenated compounds are retained. Gender alternatives are separate words. Reflexive constructions are represented by their infinitive and separate pronouns. No phrases are imported.
method.database: Read-only exact case-insensitive comparison. Database translations are reused only as reference. No database changes were made.
method.sample_note: A1, A2, A3 etc. beside sample exercises are audio-track markers, not CEFR classifications.
method.limits: Units 2–40 are absent as full lessons. Their exact lesson word lists cannot be recovered from this preview.
